## 主张 Claim

两侧局部有限且在所声明范围内关系连通，根片段对全部关联问题同测时，所有同测片段对构成共同细化，其两投影覆盖相应范围、保留接合并提升固定一个参与位置的接合。 / For locally finite, incidence-connected declared scopes with equal root answers, all equally answering fragment pairs form a common refinement whose projections cover those scopes, preserve joins and lift joins fixing one participant.

Canonical source: [ExplanatoryJoiningIncidence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningIncidence.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 两种部分三元接合 J、K，可有不同片段类型；同一六角色移动的有限分支语言。 / Two partial ternary joining laws J and K, possibly on different fragment types; the same finite branch language over six role movements.
- 每个片段／角色只有有限关联接合；两根 Related；两边 ConnectedFrom。 / Finitely many incident joins per fragment/role; Related roots and ConnectedFrom on both sides.

关联节点均有真实 J 或 K 接合见证；图路径是关系检查，不自动是时间执行。 / Incidence nodes carry actual J or K witnesses; graph paths inspect relations and are not automatically temporal executions.

The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Two joinings with alike roots, from which every fragment is reached, have a common refinement, the joining of their alike pairs, whose two projections are open and cover both, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.common_refinement); under the periphery's hypotheses, local finiteness and roots passing the same tests, with excluded middle, so do they (Joining.common_refinement_of_em). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
